mechanism: SOXX losses may become more sensitive to broad Nasdaq technology downside when sector downside beta rises beyond its ordinary market beta; this is a risk-receiver hypothesis, not a standalone direction forecast or a risk-cap switch. Distinct from existing SOXL-vs-SOXX downside beta and original39 cross-breadth/dispersion coordinates.
coordinate: At each signal-date 09:46 use last 60 completed prior Qlib sessions of SOXX and QQQ raw quote-close simple returns. Beta_all=cov(SOXX,QQQ)/var(QQQ) on 60 returns. Beta_down is the same slope only on QQQ<0 days within those 60, requiring >=15 negative days. Coordinate=Beta_down-Beta_all. No current signal-day close, thresholds or sign chosen from future returns.

SOXX same existing Yahoo raw quote-close source, no adjusted-close substitution
Qlib calendar coverage and 60-return warmup/negative-day support for original Stage1 train 2011-2022 and held 2023-2026
